New raw `raw/stripe-payments-paypal-disputed-payments-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-paypal-disputes-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-paypal-disputes.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal/disputed-payments`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal/disputed-payments, old raw lines 8-48 and new raw lines 9-49 describe the same authenticated PayPal payment and later dispute. The customer can file with PayPal within 180 calendar days or dispute via their funding method. Stripe notifies the merchant through relevant channels and the merchant can accept or counter with evidence by the category-specific 2–19-calendar-day deadline. PayPal aims to decide within 30 calendar days of evidence submission and decides outcome and eligible appeals. Funds are returned on a win or the balance charge becomes permanent on a loss, subject to how the merchant settles. Old raw lines 50-60 and new raw lines 51-61 preserve the reopened PayPal case versus separate Stripe record distinction, including a later bank dispute. source-stripe-paypal-disputes.md records this broad flow, but overstates the decision time and appeal availability and omits the new sample request.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal/disputed-payments, old raw lines 60-74 and new raw lines 61-75 contain the substantive dated test request change. The May 7, 2026 sample supplies `payment_method_types[]=paypal`; the November 7 sample uses `automatic_payment_methods[enabled]=true`, with `payment_method_data[type]=paypal` and the same billing-email scenario, `amount=1099`, and `currency=eur` (1099 euro cents). The changed sample establishes request guidance. The separate Endive changelog supplies the API-version boundary and has a different preview version in Impact. Old raw lines 76-102 and new raw lines 77-103 keep the same seven test patterns and evidence results with formatting and wording edits. Keep both dated raws, PayPal filing and appeal qualifications, 30-day aim, distinct API and Dashboard test evidence routes, and source-stripe-paypal-disputes.md reciprocal Wallets and settlement navigation with the Stripe company route.
